name: cameri-schematics
description: Agentic schematics — published build specifications that any LLM, team, or org can implement independently, with zero coordination with the author. The spec is the only coordination mechanism.

plugins.name: schematics
plugins.description: The authoring plugin — authors, reverse-engineers, and maintains agentic schematics: self-contained build specifications anyone can implement independently, without central coordination. Provides the create-schematic skill.

plugins.name: opa-docker-authz
plugins.description: Grants a sandbox container restricted Docker daemon access over TLS, policed by Open Policy Agent — certificate infrastructure, Rego policy, systemd TCP listener, and sandbox client provisioning.

plugins.name: sops-env-secrets
plugins.description: Encrypt service secrets with SOPS and age and inject them into container processes as environment variables at boot, in memory: dual-recipient encryption, a per-service key blast radius, docker-secret wiring, and rotation without rebuilds.
